verdict.rationale: A government filing portal could publish an interactive API reference, so this axis applies. However, the evidence covers only web-portal formalities, payments and signing. The one API probe concerns the separate recherche-entreprises state API, not an INPI Guichet unique API reference with runnable examples, so nothing in the pack shows this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
